title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam invoking the blessings of Maa Narayani
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam offering salutations to Maa Narayani, praising her as the most auspicious, the embodiment of divine grace and benevolence, and the fulfiller of righteous aspirations. The verse also invokes the Goddess as the protector of those who seek refuge in her and as the divine Mother Gauri.
Sharing a Sanskrit Subhashitam, Shri Modi wrote on X;
“सर्वमङ्गलमाङ्गल्ये शिवे सर्वार्थसाधिके।
शरण्ये त्र्यम्बके गौरि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥”
सर्वमङ्गलमाङ्गल्ये शिवे सर्वार्थसाधिके।

शरण्ये त्र्यम्बके गौरि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥ https://t.co/mtPPVbyL3e — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) October 14, 2026
